# Tests of the packages that .github/workflows/go-macos.yml gates that cannot
# pass on its macOS runner for host reasons, not code reasons, and tests that
# skip themselves on it.
#
# The format and the rules are those of environment-only-tests.txt beside
# this file, which .github/ci/go_test_gate.py reads and documents. The
# workflow passes the gate the package pattern in TESTED_PACKAGES, and every
# line here must name a package that the pattern names. The step "Test" of
# that workflow skips the entries and runs everything else in those
# packages. The step "Listed tests still fail" fails the run when an entry
# passes, skips itself or does not run on that runner, so a change that
# makes a listed test pass on macOS has to delete its line in the same
# change.
#
# The entries come first in this file, and the lines for tests that skip
# themselves after them, under their own heading.
#
# The way to shorten this list is to port a test so that it passes on a
# macOS runner without weakening it.

# Remote Alpha operator-host tests in the scripts package.

# The test process must run as the account named "ds", and the runner has no
# such account. The first two tests are listed whole for the reason that
# environment-only-tests.txt gives for them: the TLS status bootstrap refuses
# a caller that is not "ds" at its first identity check, so a subtest that
# expects a refusal passes without reaching the check it is named for.
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaESServiceTLSStatusFailureWitnessBootstrapOwnedTerminal
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaESServiceTLSStatusRootLoadedStageCustody
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaESServiceTLSStatusStageFIFOSubstitution
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRecoverySessionESTLSStatusStageFIFORefusal
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaP0tGrammarDiagnosticBootstrapLifecycleComposition
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaP0tGrammarDiagnosticPriorReaderCloseSuppression
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaP0tGrammarDiagnosticV2VersionedBootstrap

# On macOS, /var and /tmp are symbolic links to /private/var and
# /private/tmp. The box helpers that these tests run check every folder on
# the way to an output or backup folder and refuse a symbolic link there.
# The helpers run only on the box, where /var and /tmp are folders. The first
# four tests use a default folder under /var/tmp. The next two expect a
# refusal that names /var/tmp or /var/log, and get the refusal for the link
# /var first; the other subtests of the second one pass. The last four put
# their fake host under /tmp.
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaESBinaryDeploymentCheckOnlyIsDefaultAndNonMutating
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaESConfigTLSPrepRecordsDSSecurityWarningsWithoutFailing
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaESConfigTLSPrepRejectsPreexistingBroadPrepAccount
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaVaultServiceUserMigrationApplyRequiresReadyPreflight
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOutputDirRefusesASharedStickyFolderAsTheArtifactFolder
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaVaultServiceUserMigrationPlanRefusesPathsOutsideVault/log_file_in_a_shared_system_directory
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorPrepareSummaryPathHandsOverAnUnreadableFolder
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorPrepareSummaryPathRefusesASummaryLink
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRecoverySessionVaultWorkloadAuthBootstrapPrepareRunsBeforeHelperExecution
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRecoverySessionVaultWorkloadAuthBootstrapPrepareSummaryPathUsesBoundedRemoteCommand

# The output folder check opens each folder with O_PATH, which needs no read
# permission on it. macOS has no O_PATH, so the check falls back to O_RDONLY
# and cannot open a folder that it may not read, which this test expects it
# to check.
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOutputDirChecksFoldersItCannotRead

# The fake sshd of these tests starts with #!/bin/bash and uses associative
# arrays and ${name,,}, which need Bash 4. The /bin/bash of macOS is Bash
# 3.2. All subtests of these tests fail.
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaHostFirewallApplyConfirmRollbackOrderWithFakes
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaHostFirewallApplyFailuresLeaveNoUnconfirmedMarker
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaHostFirewallApplyRefusesOtherBridgesAndContainerIPv6
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaHostFirewallApplyRestoresAfterAFailedDropInInstall
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaHostFirewallInstallsFilesDurably
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaHostFirewallStatusChecksTheTablesAreLoaded
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaHostFirewallStatusRefusesEmptyInstalledRulesetAfterCrash
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaHostFirewallUnconfirmedApplyRecords

# The tests read a folder's owner with "stat -c %U", which is the stat of GNU
# coreutils. The stat of macOS has no -c. The other subtests of the second
# test pass.
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaResetDisposableVaultNeverFollowsALinkAboveTheRaftDirectory
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaResetDisposableVaultRefusesUnsafeRaftStates/raft_directory_of_the_Vault_account
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaResetDisposableVaultRefusesUnsafeRaftStates/raft_path_is_a_link

# The fake copy command of the "open" subtests runs chmod with "--" after the
# mode. The chmod of macOS reads options only before the mode, so it takes
# "--" for a file name and fails, and the fake copy fails before the run step
# that the test is about. The six "linked" subtests pass.
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRoutesRefuseAStageFolderThatIsNoLongerPrivate/open/operator-healthcheck-tls-renew
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRoutesRefuseAStageFolderThatIsNoLongerPrivate/open/operator-healthcheck-tls-status
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRoutesRefuseAStageFolderThatIsNoLongerPrivate/open/vault-reset-disposable-dry-run
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRoutesRefuseAStageFolderThatIsNoLongerPrivate/open/vault-reset-disposable-execute
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRoutesRefuseAStageFolderThatIsNoLongerPrivate/open/vault-unseal-existing
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaOperatorRoutesRefuseAStageFolderThatIsNoLongerPrivate/open/vault-workload-auth-bootstrap

# The test builds esconfigcheck for the host and reads its build information
# with go_build_info of the ES upgrade helper, which reads the 64-bit
# little-endian ELF files of the box and refuses anything else. On macOS the
# build is a Mach-O file.
execution-substrate/scripts TestRemoteAlphaUpgradeESReadsGoBuildInfoLikeGoVersion


# Tests that skip themselves on the runner.
